messages:
Arjun: Pushed qx-model-int4 to canary yesterday. Perf win looks solid but we're seeing a reproducible bump in hallucination failures on the "long-steps" promptset (multi-paragraph procedural content).
Tess: Can you show a concrete example and the eval diffs?
Arjun: Example redacted:
```
User: How to configure backup rotation for db cluster X?
Gold: 3 steps, specific flags, no invented names
qx-int8: Matches gold (3 steps, correct flags)
qx-int4: Adds an extra imaginary flag and omits the rotate-frequency field
```
Marta: Numbers: vs int8 baseline on long-steps: ROUGE-L -2.7, ExactMatch -3.1%, hallucination rate +0.12. Failures correlate with inputs where the model's effective KV-cache length > 48k tokens.
Tess: We changed the attention accumulation path for the int4 kernel in the runtime to reduce memory. Could be a numeric instability in softmax scaling. Any tokenizer or data changes?
Arjun: No tokenizer changes. The only diffs are the kernel tiling and a perf patch for fused-softmax-int4. Repro command: `./tools/eval_long.sh --model qx-model-int4 --prompts long-steps.json --save /tmp/qx_int4_diffs.json`
Marta: Suggest two parallel actions: 1) a focused golden refresh (microgolden) covering the long-steps failure cluster (150 items), plus a de-dupe sweep of anchors that changed after the recent seedbank reindex; 2) a quant/kernel ablation: int4 fused-softmax (current), int4 legacy-softmax, int8 baseline on same GPU.
label-bot: Created LabelFlow task LR-9001 "qx-int4 long-steps microgolden" 150 items, priority: high, ETA 36h. :robot_face:
Tess: Also run a cal/ablation matrix with `--fp32-softmax` toggle and `--legacy-attn` flag. If legacy-softmax recovers quality, we blame the fused-softmax numeric path.
Arjun: I'll run the ablation today and post diffs. Setting up evals across 3 nodes to match canary hardware.
Marta: For dedupe: use fuzzyhash threshold 0.79 and anchor provenance check. Command: `python infra/dedupe.py --in long-steps.json --out long-steps-dedup.json --t 0.79 --provenance anchorbank-v2`
Tess: Good. On routing: ops-bot can we set a quick fallback for requests with tokens>600 to go to int8-canary while we triage?
ops-bot: Fallback route created: token_count>600 -> qx-model-int8-canary. Enabled at 2791010022.
arjun: Thanks. We'll avoid exposing users to potential regression while we debug.
Marta: Labeling ops: set QA pass at 94% for the microgolden batch and include an "entity-invented" annotation tag. We need to separate hallucination type (fabricated facts vs omission).
label-bot: Added QA tag "entity-invented" to LR-9001 and set QA threshold 94%.
Tess: If relabel confirms regression and ablation isolates fused-softmax as the cause, we should open a runtime rollback ticket to switch back to legacy-softmax for int4 and re-run perf tests. Keep rollback scoped to canary to avoid large perf regressions.
runtime-bot: Created ticket RT-3142 "rollback fused-softmax int4 on canary" assigned to eng-runtime.
Arjun: I'll aggregate ablation results and label diffs here. If both point to numeric drift, we'll coordinate rollback + small golden refresh. ETA 24-36h.
Marta: Thanks — please @channel when you have the relabel summary. Also capture seedbank provenance to rule out sample misalignment. :white_check_mark:
